answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the ocean accrues. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the lantern of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Scaling the ridge therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal zv3r1.
